name: game-document-transport
goal: A valid game document of up to 1 MiB saves and reopens over the local transport; phone requests stay bounded at 64 KiB.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Valid near-1MiB games must save and read through local multipart transport. UTF-8 byte limits, stale revisions, original modes and failure cleanup must remain consistent.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing transport used large responses but small requests; document roundtrips were ASCII and small. Extend the same standard fixtures with near-cap game requests, Unicode, permission preservation and replacement failures; retain phone bounds.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At b7139eb0c the standard repository and real-socket tests fail on mode preservation, Unicode overflow, replacement cleanup and a valid near-1MiB request. Cache-free normal entrypoints preserve valid snapshot boundaries.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Use a bounded local-only 1MiB plus envelope request limit on both ends, retaining remote defaults and frame caps. Save and read use UTF-8 bytes, preserve modes and clean failed temporary replacements.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired b7139eb0c to dcc6aa077 keeps the same tests, fixtures, command and environment. Full-size local saves, UTF-8 rejection, mode preservation and failed-write cleanup pass; remote defaults remain 64KiB.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
